strings.【重点监护】开始作战时，使场上每个不同等阶的1个随机我方干员的所属盟约层数+2: [Intensive Care] At the start of combat, 1 random friendly operator of each different tier on the field has its alliance layers +2
strings.【众志合一】场上存在3、4或5种以上激活盟约时，所有干员攻击力、生命值分别+20: [United Wills] With 3, 4 or 5+ different alliances active on the field, all operators' ATK and HP +20/30/40% respectively
strings.【广交豪杰】每回合前2次主动刷新为特殊刷新：优先刷新出1名<炎>干员\n<@ba:
[Well Connected] The first 2 manual refreshes each round become special refreshes: they prioritize showing 1 <Yan> operator
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Yan> operators are absent</>
strings.【猎头顾问】每次主动刷新均变为特殊刷新：必定刷新2名同名干员，并冻结其中一名；第:
[Headhunter] Every manual refresh becomes a special refresh: it always shows 2 operators with the same name and freezes one of them; gain 1 <Pager Module> in Round 10
<@ba.acrem><Pager Module>: Destroyed when equipped; immediately performs a special refresh of the Dispatch Center, showing 3 operators that share an alliance with this operator; obtain one of them for free! (tier not higher than the current Dispatch Center level)</>
strings.在【标准模拟】中通过第9回合后解锁: Unlocked after passing Round 9 in [Standard Simulation]
strings.【私募基金】在第1、4、7、10回合进入休整期时获得1个<骑士储蓄罐>\n<@b:
[Private Fund] Gain 1 <Knight's Piggy Bank> when entering the Rest Phase in Rounds 1, 4, 7 and 10
<@ba.acrem><Knight's Piggy Bank>: When equipped, gain 1~6 Funds at random and it is destroyed</>
strings.【命结之秘】战斗中前3个被击倒的干员立刻复活！: [Secret of the Lifeknot] The first 3 operators defeated in combat are revived immediately!
strings.在【险境模拟】中通过第9回合后解锁: Unlocked after passing Round 9 in [Hazard Simulation]
strings.【得闲饮茶】第1、2回合的资金暂存至第3回合发放；第3回合进入休整期时，获得2、: [Drop By for Tea] The Funds of Rounds 1 and 2 are held until Round 3; when entering the Rest Phase of Round 3, gain 1 random Tier II operator and 1 random Tier IV operator
strings.通关任意模拟2次解锁: Unlocked after clearing any simulation 2 times
strings.【通关奖励】每使用20资金，获得一名不高于当前调度中心等级的随机干员: [Pro Gamer] For every 20 Funds spent, gain a random operator with tier not exceeding the current Dispatch Center level
strings.在【险境模拟】中通过第13回合后解锁: Unlocked after passing Round 13 in [Hazard Simulation]
strings.【博学多通】升级调度中心至2、4和6级后，获得1次特殊刷新：此次刷新出现的干员优:
[Polymath] After upgrading the Dispatch Center to Lv. 2, 4 and 6, gain 1 special refresh each time: the operators it shows are preferentially <Sargon> operators
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Sargon> operators are absent</>
strings.通关时的结算阵容中，包含6名【萨尔贡】干员解锁: Unlocked when the lineup at the clear settlement includes 6 [Sargon] operators
strings.【人才盲盒】从第4回合开始每2回合获得1名<维多利亚>干员\n<@ba.vdow:
[Talent Blind Box] From Round 4 on, gain 1 <Victoria> operator every 2 rounds
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Victoria> operators are absent</>
strings.通关时的结算阵容中，包含6名【维多利亚】干员解锁: Unlocked when the lineup at the clear settlement includes 6 [Victoria] operators
strings.【雪域礼赠】每回合购买的首名<谢拉格>干员消耗资金为1\n<@ba.vdown>:
[Gift of the Snows] The first <Kjerag> operator you buy each round costs 1 Fund
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Kjerag> operators are absent</>
strings.通关时的结算阵容中，包含6名【谢拉格】干员解锁: Unlocked when the lineup at the clear settlement includes 6 [Kjerag] operators
strings.【定制铳械】累计花费55资金后，获得1名4阶及以上随机的精锐<拉特兰>干员\n<:
[Custom Firearm] After spending a total of 55 Funds, gain 1 random Elite <Laterano> operator of Tier IV or above
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Laterano> operators are absent</>
strings.多场模拟中【拉特兰】盟约累计200层解锁: Unlocked by accumulating 200 layers of the [Laterano] alliance across multiple simulations
strings.【崇高牺牲】<阿戈尔>干员被击倒时，提供等同于该干员等阶的<阿戈尔>盟约层数\n:
[Noble Sacrifice] When an <Ægir> operator is defeated, it provides <Ægir> alliance layers equal to its tier
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Ægir> operators are absent</>
strings.多场模拟中【阿戈尔】盟约累计200层解锁: Unlocked by accumulating 200 layers of the [Ægir] alliance across multiple simulations
strings.【加急调派】我方干员每次部署后再部署时间减少50%: [Rapid Redeployment] Each time a friendly operator is deployed, its Redeploy Time is reduced by 50%
strings.通关时本局内，累计获取过6名特种干员解锁: Unlocked by clearing a simulation in which you acquired 6 Specialist operators in total
strings.【药枚实验】战斗开始时，使最右边的所有我方单位获得效果：每次攻击时有25%的概率: [Experimental Pills] At the start of combat, all friendly units on the far right gain this effect: each attack has a 25% chance to grant 1 layer of Shield (up to 1 layer)
strings.通关任意模拟4次解锁: Unlocked after clearing any simulation 4 times
strings.【回收利用】地面干员技能结束时使周围四格随机1名干员获得3点技力: [Reuse, Recycle] When a ground operator's skill ends, 1 random operator in the 4 surrounding tiles gains 3 SP
strings.通关任意模拟3次解锁: Unlocked after clearing any simulation 3 times
strings.【不稳定要素】第3回合获得1件特殊装备<突变细胞>\n<@ba.acrem><突:
[Unstable Element] Gain 1 special gear <Mutant Cells> in Round 3
<@ba.acrem><Mutant Cells>: After combat ends, the carrier is replaced by a random operator of one tier higher (up to Tier VI)</>
strings.【文火慢炖】第8回合开始时，若仅激活了1个盟约，使其增加36层；否则使所有已激活: [Slow Simmer] At the start of Round 8, if only 1 alliance is active, it gains 36 layers; otherwise all active alliances gain 12 layers
strings.【加练！】每2个回合获得1个特殊法术<教鞭>\n<@ba.acrem><教鞭>：:
[Extra Drills!] Gain 1 special Art <Teacher's Pointer> every 2 rounds
<@ba.acrem><Teacher's Pointer>: After use, adds extra enemies to the next battle; if your own battle is a Perfect Combat, you can gain Funds</>
strings.通关任意模拟1次解锁: Unlocked after clearing any simulation 1 time
strings.【定向投放】每次升级调度中心时，在调度中心刷新随机3件装备，可以选择并获得其中1: [Targeted Delivery] Each time you upgrade the Dispatch Center, 3 random pieces of gear are shown in it, and you can choose and take 1 of them
strings.【商业包装】初始获得1个<商业包装方案>\n<@ba.acrem><商业包装方案:
[Commercial Packaging] Start with 1 <Commercial Packaging Plan>
<@ba.acrem><Commercial Packaging Plan>: After every 8 operators sold (any operators), gain 1 non-Elite operator that shares an alliance with the carrier</>
strings.【食腐之蝶】我方干员被击倒时，场上剩余我方单位攻击力+20%（最大200%，持续: [Carrion Butterfly] When a friendly operator is defeated, the remaining friendly units on the field gain ATK +20% (max 200%, lasting until that operator is defeated or combat ends)
strings.【以己之长】所有干员造成的物理和法术伤害变为弱点伤害（根据敌人的防御力和法术抗性: [Play to Your Strengths] All operators' Physical and Arts damage becomes Weakness damage (the damage type is converted based on the enemy's DEF and RES)
strings.【变形同构】每5回合获得1件特殊装备<变形同构体>\n<@ba.acrem><变:
[Polymorphic Isomorphism] Gain 1 special gear <Polymorphic Isomorph> every 5 rounds
<@ba.acrem><Polymorphic Isomorph>: When equipped together with specific gear, the carrier counts as a member of a specific alliance</>
strings.【优等生】第1回合获得1名可以造成神经、灼燃、凋亡损伤的特殊干员，其属于调和盟约: [Honor Student] Gain 1 special operator in Round 1 who can deal Nervous Impairment, Burn Damage and Necrosis Damage; it belongs to the [Harmony] alliance and can add +1 to the member count of some alliances
strings.【墨色真颜】若你的场上存在同名干员，这些干员攻击力+30%\n【幻画为真】第1回:
[True Colors in Ink] If you have operators with the same name on the field, their ATK +30%
[Painting Made Real] Gain 1 special Art <Picture Scroll> in Round 1
<@ba.acrem><Picture Scroll>: After use, can replicate 1 operator within this Art's range (including Elite status and equipped gear)</>
strings.【利滚利】每回合剩余的资金可以继承，剩余至少5资金时，每回合额外获得1资金: [Compound Interest] Funds left over each round carry over; with at least 5 Funds left over, gain 1 additional Fund each round
strings.【“神秘顾客”】从第5回合起，你和队友遭遇的部分敌人可能会替换为<鸭爵><高普尼: ['Mystery Customer'] From Round 5, some of the enemies that you and your teammates face may be replaced by <Duck Lord>, <Gopnik>, <Crying Thief> or <Fatty>; whoever defeats these enemies gains a reward of 1 Fund (including during the Unite Phase)
strings.【御守之力】每个回合开始时，触发战场上一名干员的获得时效果一次（优先选择最靠右和: [Power of the Omamori] At the start of each round, triggers the 'On Acquisition' effect of 1 operator on the battlefield once (prefers the rightmost and lowest)
strings.【替身娃娃】每回合首次出售初始干员时，改为与调度中心中随机一名干员交换: [Substitute Doll] The first time each round you sell a non-Elite operator, it is instead swapped with a random operator in the Dispatch Center
strings.【统御号令】战斗开始时，场上每有一个精锐干员，精锐干员的攻击力，生命值+10%: [Supreme Command] At the start of combat, for every Elite operator on the field, the ATK and HP of Elite operators +10%
strings.【集结指示】在第4、7、10、13回合进入休整期时获得1个<寻呼模块>\n<@b:
[Rally Orders] Gain 1 <Pager Module> when entering the Rest Phase in Rounds 4, 7, 10 and 13
<@ba.acrem><Pager Module>: Destroyed when equipped; immediately performs a special refresh of the Dispatch Center, showing 3 operators that share an alliance with this operator; obtain one of them for free! (tier not higher than the current Dispatch Center level)</>
strings.【至纯凝结】在第1回合开始时获得一个进阶<博士投影>\n<@ba.acrem>进:
[Pure Condensation] Gain 1 Advanced <Doctor Hologram> at the start of Round 1
<@ba.acrem>Advanced <Doctor Hologram>: Any operator can equip it; immediately promotes that operator to Elite</>
strings.【九流之缘】偶数回合的休整期开始时，随机获得调度中心的一名干员: [All Walks of Life] At the start of the Rest Phase of even-numbered rounds, gain 1 random operator from the Dispatch Center
strings.【协力共进】第8、10、12、14回合时，获得1个<信标>\n<@ba.acre:
[Advance Together] Gain 1 <Transmitter> in Rounds 8, 10, 12 and 14
<@ba.acrem><Transmitter>: When equipped, the carrier is destroyed and the Dispatch Center refreshes 2 operators of the same tier, 1 of which you get for free; next round, the original operator is passed to the teammate with the most members of the corresponding alliance</>
strings.【业务指标】每购买一名<卡西米尔>干员，下回合开始时资金+1（每回合至多3资金）:
[Sales Quota] For each <Kazimierz> operator you buy, Funds +1 at the start of the next round (up to 3 Funds per round)
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Kazimierz> operators are absent</>
strings.通关时的结算阵容中，包含6名【卡西米尔】干员解锁: Unlocked when the lineup at the clear settlement includes 6 [Kazimierz] operators
strings.【团伙行动】主动刷新6次调度中心后获得一名不高于当前调度中心等级的<叙拉古>干员:
[Gang Operation] After manually refreshing the Dispatch Center 6 times, gain 1 <Siracusa> operator not above the current Dispatch Center level (up to 2 per round)
<@ba.vdown>The experience may be incomplete while some <Siracusa> operators are absent</>
strings.通关时的结算阵容中，包含6名【叙拉古】干员解锁: Unlocked when the lineup at the clear settlement includes 6 [Siracusa] operators
strings.【见者有份】偶数回合进入休整期时，调度中心特殊刷新两件装备，免费获取其中一件；萨:
